title: Concept: Registry token passed as a build argument in dockerfile — review required
description: In dockerfile, a credential is passed through ARG. Docker stores build arguments in the image configuration and history, so a token supplied this way survives as long as the image does and is readable by anyone who can pull it. BuildKit secret mounts exist specifically to keep the value out of image layers.
applicability: dockerfile images that install private packages.
risk: Registry credential disclosure from the image; MEDIUM severity.
